modern.title: Modern CoD (MW4, BO7, Warzone, BO6, MW3, MWII)

sections.name: Controller
items: Keeps the slow-down and rotational help that controller aim relies on.
Lower = more responsive. Raise it if your stick drifts.
Rumble and resistance make small aim corrections harder.
General starting point — tune it in the Firing Range.

sections.name: View
items: Wider view spots flanks; too wide shrinks targets.
Blur hides enemies while you turn.

sections.name: Graphics (PC)
items: Big FPS cost for no competitive gain.
On — re-run after every GPU driver update

sections.name: Console
items: 120 Hz if your TV supports it

sections.name: Graphics & audio
items: Max FPS matters more than visuals in MP and BR.
Depth of field, real-time shadows, bloom
Clearer view and fewer FPS drops in Battle Royale.

sections.name: Basic
items: CODM's aim assist helps on touch screens.
AR & LMG: ADS · SMG: ADS or hip · Shotgun: hip
Higher sees more, lower makes targets bigger.

sections.name: Sensitivity
items: No sudden jump when you aim in.
A pro's numbers — copy them, then tune to your phone.
Fine aim by tilting the phone.

sections.name: General
items: As high as the game allows (90+)
Off, cap FPS just under your refresh rate

mw4.note: Modern Warfare 4 launched 23 Oct 2026. Builds use the Apex attachment at max weapon level where listed.

warzone.note: Warzone loadouts carry two guns: one long range, one close range. Black Ops 7 guns are now Legacy weapons with preset builds.
